approach: Modify the `__init__` method of the `Entity` class to process each key-value pair in the `properties` dictionary through `__setitem__`, ensuring that any Entity values are properly handled by the existing custom setter logic before being stored.
hypothesis: When initializing an Entity via Entity.__init__, properties containing other Entity objects must trigger the custom __setitem__ logic to ensure proper internal serialization, instead of being directly assigned to `_props`. Currently, these nested Entities remain unconverted during JSON-LD dump, causing a TypeError.
